 How to Watch & Listen 
 Presented by How to Watch and Listen | Week 9: Jets vs. Chiefs
 Here’s how to catch the game on Sunday
 Nov 06, 2026 at 04:26 PM Matt McMullen Senior Team Reporter
 Copied! 
 The Kansas City Chiefs return to Arrowhead Stadium on Sunday to take on the New York Jets.
 Here's how to catch the game.
 Game Time 
 Sunday, November 8 at 12:00 p.m. CT on CBS
 Location 
 Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri
 TV Coverage 
 CBS (KCTV5 locally)
 Play-by-Play: Jim Nantz
 Analyst: J.J. Watt
 Sideline: Tracy Wolfson
 The game will also be available on Paramount+. For more information, click here .
 NFL+ 
 Your Game. On the Go. NFL+ empowers you with on-demand, on-the-go access to live games, game replays, and much more, so you'll never miss a moment. With NFL+ you'll be able to watch local and primetime games, every playoff game and the Super Bowl on mobile. Start your 7-day free trial today!
 To get NFL+, click here .
 Field Pass LIVE on YouTube Pre-Game 
 Senior Team Reporter Matt McMullen and Voice of the Chiefs Mitch Holthus will preview the game on the Chiefs' YouTube page beginning at 10:00 a.m. CT.
 The Chiefs' official YouTube page can be found by clicking here .
 Chiefs Rewind LIVE on YouTube Post-Game 
 Voice of the Chiefs Mitch Holthus and Senior Team Reporter Matt McMullen will recap the game on the Chiefs' YouTube page approximately 30 minutes following the final whistle.
 Radio 
 Chiefs Radio Network - 96.5 The Fan (96.5 FM) 
 Play-by-Play: Mitch Holthus
 Color: Danan Hughes
 Sideline: Josh Klingler
 Chiefs Pre-Game and Post-Game Show – 96.5 The Fan (96.5 FM) 
 Spanish Radio Broadcast | Tico Sports (Kansas City) – Audacy App (Chiefs en Español) 
 Play-by-Play: Oscar Monterroso
 Color: Hannah Bassham
 Sideline: Alvaro Alvarez
 Social Media 
 Be sure to follow the Chiefs on X (formerly Twitter) for live game day updates, videos and behind-the-scenes photos:
 @Chiefs | @KCChiefsMatt | @ChiefsPR
